svg.aria-label: How Connect AI × DOOM works. You ask a question. Claude explores your apps through the Connect AI MCP server, with read-only tools only, and picks the three apps that answer it, here Salesforce, Zendesk and Stripe. What it finds becomes the level: each app becomes a room; each record becomes a monster, urgent ones are pink demons, and shooting one reads the record again, live; your permissions become keycards, blue for read only and yellow for read and write; and data Connect AI blocked, like a lookup by Social Security number, sits behind the red door, which has no key and gets refused again every time you try it.

g.text: shoot one: read it again, live
